# WHIZTY

> WHIZTY is a daily life-skills app for kids aged 7 to 12 that turns about 10 minutes of everyday screen time into fun missions for building confidence, smart money habits, leadership and real-world readiness. It is an Android app, used by children together with a parent or guardian, made in India.

## Key facts

- Who it is for: children aged 7 to 12. A parent or guardian registers and the child uses the app on the parent's phone.
- What children learn: Social Courage (speaking up, confidence), Smart Money Habits, Leadership, Entrepreneurship and AI. More modules are being added.
- How it works: one short mission a day (about 10 minutes), with points, streaks and badges, and a daily rest rule that keeps screen time healthy. Some missions use the microphone for speaking practice.
- Platform: Android. Currently in Google Play closed testing; parents can ask for early access by emailing support@whizty.com
- Pricing (INR): Level 1 (the first 8 daily missions) is free with no card, UPI or sales calls. Level 2 onwards is coming soon: ₹199 for 1 month or ₹599 for 4 months (about 25% cheaper than four single months). Each payment is one-time and does not renew, so there is nothing to cancel. Within 7 days of paying, parents can email for a full refund. The price shown is the full amount; at present no GST is charged. Payments are handled by Razorpay.

## Privacy and safety

- No advertising, no profiling, no tracking and no analytics tools in the app.
- Children are never asked for a real name, birth date, school or location.
- The child's nickname, progress, points, badges and voice recordings stay only on the phone and are never uploaded.
- Parent data is limited to what is needed to log in, record consent and handle payments. Parents can delete their account at any time.
